content_sections.heading: TMC SENIOR RESIDENT (HEMATOPATHOLOGY) Overview
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the date of the MCQ test or interview.

rows.details: Tata Memorial Centre, Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital (HBCH) and Mahamana Pandit Madan Mohan Malaviya Cancer Centre (MPMMCC), Varanasi
Rs. 1,33,623/- to Rs. 1,40,238/- monthly remuneration (Senior Resident I to III)
Tenured, fixed period up to 31.07.2027, further extendable subject to the requirements of the centre

content_sections.heading: About Tata Memorial Centre, Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital, Varanasi
content_sections.text: Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital, Varanasi is described in the notice as a grant-in-aid institute under the Department of Atomic Energy, Government of India, and is part of Tata Memorial Centre, Mumbai. The post serves Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital and Mahamana Pandit Madan Mohan Malaviya Cancer Centre, Varanasi. The notice is issued by the Dean (Academics), HBCH/MPMMCC, Varanasi.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice does not print a category-wise break-up. Tata Memorial Centre reserves the right to cancel or increase/decrease the number of advertised posts.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The post table states the qualification as M.D./D.N.B. (Pathology) or equivalent postgraduate degree recognized by NMC. All undergraduate, postgraduate and super-specialty degrees must be recognized by the National Medical Commission (NMC). Applicants must be Indian Nationals. The maximum age limit is 45 years. Age and experience are reckoned as on 24.11.2026. Relaxation is as per applicable rules. Candidates whose result is awaited may apply where applicable, but must produce proof of having passed the required degree at the MCQ/Interview. Without it they will not be permitted to appear. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The post is tenure based for a fixed period up to 31.07.2027, further extendable subject to the requirements of the centre. A security/caution deposit is listed: Rs. 1,33,623/- for Senior Resident I, Rs. 1,36,269/- for Senior Resident II and Rs. 1,40,238/- for Senior Resident III. Selected and appointed candidates must be registered with the Uttar Pradesh Medical Council, as applicable. No TA/DA (Travel Allowance / Dearness Allowance) is admissible to candidates appearing for the MCQ/interview.

rows.qualification_and_experience: M.D. / D.N.B (Pathology) with 1 Year of experience
M.D. / D.N.B (Pathology) with 2 years of experience

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee is paid online using Debit Card / Credit Card / UPI. The fee paid will not be refunded under any circumstances.

rows.category: Candidates not in an exempted category
SC / ST / Female Candidates / Persons with Disabilities / Ex-servicemen (1st time applying for civil post after serving any rank)

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notice mentions shortlisting, an MCQ examination that may be held before the interview, and an interview. Tata Memorial Centre reserves the right to prescribe minimum eligibility standards or benchmarks and to restrict the number of candidates called for the MCQ/interview, based on the number of vacancies and candidates' performance. Meeting the eligibility criteria does not give a right to be called. The MCQ examination may be conducted before the interview for shortlisting. The Dean (Academics), HBCH/MPMMCC, Varanasi has discretion to decide this, and the decision is final. The Centre may prescribe minimum eligibility standards or cut-off marks, including Groups/Stream/Discipline/Category-wise cut-offs, for shortlisting for the interview and for final selection after the interview. The decision of the Director, HBCH/MPMMCC, Varanasi is final and no representation will be entertained.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for TMC SENIOR RESIDENT (HEMATOPATHOLOGY)
content_sections.text: Open the online application on the Tata Memorial Centre website: https://tmc.gov.in/postmaster/Careers . Complete the online application form in all respects. Incomplete applications are rejected and no other mode of application is accepted. Submit documentary evidence in support of the details furnished in the form. Pay the Rs. 300/- fee online unless exempted. Submit the application by 24.11.2026, 05:30 p.m. (IST). Candidates need not send a hard copy. Submit a separate application for each post. All correspondence is made through the e-mail ID [email protected] . Candidates must give their latest mobile number and a valid e-mail ID. The Centre is not responsible for non-receipt of communications due to online submission errors, incorrect e-mail IDs or mails going to spam/bulk folders.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Proof of date of birth Qualification certificates Experience proof Caste/category certificate, wherever applicable Disability certificate, wherever applicable No Objection Certificate (NOC), wherever applicable Other relevant documents Failure to provide the required documents results in the application being treated as incomplete and summarily rejected.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates currently employed with a Government or Government related organization (Central / State Government / Autonomous Body / Semi Government Organization) must obtain a NOC from their employer, issued through the Head of their Institution/Department, and upload it with the online application. Such candidates must also produce the original NOC at the MCQ test/Interview; without it they will be disallowed from appearing. An application is rejected if incorrect or false information is given. No correspondence is entertained. TMC reserves the right to reject any or all applications without assigning any reason. Any dispute is subject to the exclusive legal jurisdiction of Varanasi.

faq.question: Q1. How many Senior Resident vacancies are there at Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital, Varanasi?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Senior Resident (Hematopathology) in the Department of Onco Pathology.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for TMC Senior Resident (Hematopathology)?
faq.answer: The last date is 24.11.2026, up to 05:30 p.m. (Indian Standard Time). Applications are online only.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: M.D./D.N.B. (Pathology) or an equivalent postgraduate degree recognized by NMC. Senior Resident II needs 1 year and Senior Resident III needs 2 years of experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 45 years as on 24.11.2026, relaxable by 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC and 10 years for PwD, as per applicable rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a Senior Resident at TMC Varanasi?
faq.answer: Monthly remuneration is Rs. 1,33,623/- for Senior Resident I, Rs. 1,36,269/- for Senior Resident II and Rs. 1,40,238/- for Senior Resident III.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 300/-, paid online by Debit Card, Credit Card or UPI. SC, ST, female candidates, PwD and ex-servicemen (1st time applying for civil post after serving any rank) are exempted.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply?
faq.answer: Apply online through https://tmc.gov.in/postmaster/Careers. No other mode is accepted and no hard copy is required.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted, an MCQ examination may be held before the interview, and final selection follows the interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent post?
faq.answer: No, it is a tenure-based position for a fixed period up to 31.07.2027, further extendable subject to the requirements of the centre.

faq.question: Q10. Do government employees need an NOC?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates employed with a Government or Government related organization must upload an NOC with the online application and produce the original at the MCQ test/Interview.
